name: theme-toggle-reveal
title: Theme Toggle Reveal
description: A pill toggle labelled Light mode or Dark mode. Click it and the new theme is drawn in pixels out from the toggle, in one of eight reveals: circle, diamond, equalizer bars, a diagonal sweep, a zipper closing from top and bottom, sparks, sonar rings or a spiral. View Transitions API with the cross-fade switched off; the sun pulls in its rays and the label turns like a drum.
